_comment: Hand-authored from the printed BING3D PETG-LS spool label -- BING3D
(bing-3d.com) publishes no Bambu Studio export and no downloadable TDS,
so unlike reference-esun/ and reference-old-repo/ this is not a vendor
export snapshot. See CLAUDE.md 'Vendors' and REFERENCES.md 'External
references'.
Label data (the ONLY vendor-stated numbers here):
print (nozzle) temperature: 205-225 C
bed temperature:            0-50 C
Derived from that label:
nozzle_temperature / _initial_layer = 215 (midpoint of 205-225), same
value on every extruder variant -- the label gives one range, not a
per-variant figure.
nozzle_temperature_range_low/high   = 205 / 225, straight off the label.
hot/eng/textured/supertack_plate_temp (and their _initial_layer twins)
= 50, the top of the label's bed range. The template's PETG values
(70-80) are above what the label allows, so they must be overridden.
filament_tower_interface_print_temp = 215, kept in step with the nozzle
temperature -- the PETG template's 255 exceeds the label's 225 maximum.
Deliberately NOT set (no label or datasheet figure exists -- these stay
at the donor PETG bundle's already-validated values):
cool_plate_temp stays 0, i.e. Bambu's Cool Plate stays marked
incompatible. The low bed range would physically allow it, but PETG
bonds aggressively to that plate's coating and BING3D makes no
plate-compatibility claim; that is a materials call, not a
temperature one.
filament_flow_ratio, filament_max_volumetric_speed, fan/cooling,
retraction, drying temperatures.
name: BING3D PETG-LS Filament
